mapper.select: SELECT o.*, p.title AS product_title, p.image_url AS product_image_url, b.nickname AS buyer_nickname, s.nickname AS seller_nickname FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN user b ON o.buyer_id = b.id LEFT JOIN user s ON o.seller_id = s.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
mapper.insert:
